label: Trial sequence
description: Every trial family and its ordered auditory, tactile, wait, and source-selection elements, with method-defining within-trial timing and condition intermixing.

label: Task and response
description: Target/no-target rule, response or explicit passive/no-response mode, device/mapping, and any method-defining response-window anchor or scoring policy. The current design serializer has no first-class response contract.
